summary: Found while diagnosing a user-reported bench failure that looked like their own last-frame-only edit. It was not. ComfyUI f8a3fd9d (2026-07-25) converted LatentUpscaleModelLoader's return to a ModelPatcher/ModelPatcherDynamic; KJNodes' OuterSampleCallbackWrapper still called latent_upscale_model.to(device), and neither patcher class defines .to - proven by hasattr against the ENGINE's own python. Every shipped LTX graph (all 12) wires that optional input, so the whole LTX fleet dies at the stage-1 sampler on 0.30.x. The engine ships ComfyUI 0.30.0 which already contains the breaking commit, and KJNodes 1.4.7 without the fix, so this is a product regression from the H3 engine bump, not a bench-only problem. kijai fixed it in 827fe6e (2026-07-28) with the message 'Update ltxv_nodes.py' - the _unwrap_upscale_model helper. Pin bumped 7f43f2c -> 35e5956 (upstream head, 38 commits, no requirements change, neither ImageResizeKJv2 nor LTX2SamplingPreviewOverride renamed). PROVEN LIVE on the bench: the exact failing prompt re-queued after the bump ran the whole graph to completion in 124s.
